title: papaver somniferum subsp. officinale
intro: Papaver somniferum subsp. officinale, commonly known as opium poppy, is a plant species belonging to the poppy family (Papaveraceae) and is known for its medicinal and psychoactive properties. The health benefits of this plant include its use in pain relief, cough suppression, and as a sedative, making it a valuable component in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Papaver somniferum subsp. officinale include analgesia, antitussive, and antispasmodic effects, which are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents. The plant contains a range of bioactive compounds, including alkaloids such as morphine, codeine, and thebaine, which contribute to its medicinal and psychoactive properties.
